checks.detail: TaskSpec envelope payload_sha256 matches the committed T3 spec; allowed_files cover operations.py, the operations test, and all six evidence outputs; baseline and seven input evidence references hash-match live files.

incremental_project reads last_sequence from the projections table and selects only events with sequence > last_sequence in ascending order, so work is O(new events); the projection advances to the new last_sequence in one durable transaction.

rebuild_projection performs a full ordered scan from sequence 1, verifies contiguity, reports progress to the caller, enforces an optional max_events threshold, and writes the rebuilt projection in one durable transaction; threshold/integrity failures roll back and leave the projection untouched.

backup_journal and restore_journal use the SQLite online backup API with progress callbacks and destination parent creation; protected authority/operational paths are rejected before any connection opens.

The only tracked source changes are research_automation/control_plane/operations.py and tests/test_control_plane_operations.py; no sealed TCB, run_research.py, policy, inventory, or store file changed.

The new tests failed at import before implementation (RED), then passed 15/15 after implementation (GREEN): incremental only-new events, no-op projection, full rebuild with progress, threshold abort, integrity gap, backup/restore row preservation, backup progress, and protected-path rejection.

Authority pre-state is slice-completion ready: authorization CLAIMED, grant ACTIVE, T3 ticket ISSUED with zero trusted receipts, one open ticket, succeeded=(T1,T2), no failed/in-doubt, pending outbox 0, no P7 closure.
